identify: The young caterpillars live together and scrape the leaf. The leaf looks papery white.
Later the caterpillars make irregular holes in the leaves.
damage: Heavy attack removes most of the leaves. The caterpillars also make holes in the fruits.

thresholds.etl: Groundnut: Spodoptera / Helicoverpa 2 larvae/plant or 20-25% defoliation at 40 days.

cultural: Install pheromone traps at 4-5/acre to monitor the moths.
biological: Release the egg parasitoid Trichogramma pretiosum at 20,000/acre/week four times.
Spray NSKE 5% against the eggs and first instar larvae.

cultural: Install pheromone traps at 4-5/acre to monitor the moths.
Grow castor as a trap crop for egg laying.
Erect bird perches at 20/acre for predatory birds.
